title: MPR-GUI: Benchmarking and Enhancing Multilingual Perception and Reasoning in GUI Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the accuracy of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) on fine-grained Graphical User Interface (GUI) Visual Question Answering (VQA) tasks across six parallel language settings (English, Chinese, French, Russian, Japanese, Thai) to measure cross-lingual performance gaps.
